# Database Migration Procedures

Structured approach to safely executing database schema changes and data migrations.

## Migration Types
- Schema changes (DDL)
- Data migrations (DML)
- Index creation/modification
- Constraint additions/removals
- Stored procedure updates

## Safety Measures
- Comprehensive testing on staging
- Transaction-based execution
- Automated rollback procedures
- Data validation checks
- Performance impact assessment

## Deployment Coordination
- Application code compatibility
- Blue-green deployment strategies
- Zero-downtime migration techniques
- Monitoring and alerting during migration

structured_sections.overview: Safe database migration and schema change procedures
